Getting started

  1. Open YaCatala with your child. The street shows a gegant for every sound your child knows.
  2. Pick a sound page, then one of the three games: Busca el dibuix (read the word, find its picture), L'intrús (find the picture without the sound) or Pica les síl·labes (tap the drum once per syllable).
  3. Choose how to play: Junts (take turns, and get some wrong on purpose so your child can teach you), Qui guanya? (a friendly challenge) or Sol (your child alone).
  4. Each week, do the Missió del so together: find three things with the sound, at home or outside.

The parent area

Tap Adults in the corner of the street. A short check keeps children out.

Making the app match your child's school

In the parent area, add the sound your child is learning now, in the order their school follows:

  • Photograph the worksheet from the school book, or choose a photo of it. The app cuts out the pictures, even if your child has drawn on them.
  • Start from a suggested page for any sound.
  • Add or edit words one by one in the pages and words list.

Missing pictures and Image Playground

On iPhones and iPads with Apple Intelligence, Image Playground can draw pictures for words that don't have one. It opens once for each picture: accept a drawing and the next one opens. On a device without Apple Intelligence, make the pictures on one that has it.

Age and letters

  • Age: 5–7 starts with four pictures to choose from and adds more as your child learns the words. 8 or older shows every picture from the start. If your child already reads the page's words without help, try 8 or older.
  • Letters: choose capitals if your child only reads capital letters so far.

Starting a sound again

Open the sound in the parent area and choose to start it again. Your child will see its words as new, and its gegant goes back to the store. Words and pictures are kept. This can't be undone.

Troubleshooting

The words are read in a strange voice

YaCatala reads words with the device's own Catalan voice. If it isn't installed, another voice is used. Install it in Settings › Accessibility › Spoken Content › Voices › Catalan, or record the words yourself in the parent area.

A worksheet photo came out wrong

Retake it flat, in good light, with the whole page in the frame. You can fix any word or picture afterwards in the pages and words list.

Your data

Everything stays on your device: pages, pictures, recordings and progress. There are no accounts, no ads and no analytics. The parent area can export a copy of your pages and answers as files that stay on the device until you share them. The privacy policy has the details.
